description: Fork of exp530 (residual_lut nap=6/tph=256 = 1.4731, current best, 108.3M). ONLY change: residual_lut nap 6->4 at tph=256 (16 rows vs 64; weight tph*2^nap*384: 256*64*384=6.29M -> 256*16*384=1.57M/layer, -28.3M -> ~80M total). Tests whether the residual decoder prefers wide-shallow (nap=4, like qk) or deep (nap=6, like v_lut). Much smaller model. vs exp530 1.4731 (nap=6), exp513 1.4825.
